VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 31 tests pass and describes a specific fix (switching to integer cents), there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly require that "all 31 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation. Without CI logs, test results, or a reviewable diff, there is no way to independently confirm the fix was applied correctly or that the tests actually pass.
